biggest_catch: Every survey pays a flat $1 no matter how long it takes — a 20-minute survey earns the same as a 5-minute one — and surveys are not guaranteed, so the effective hourly rate is low; only short surveys are worth doing.
catches: Flat $1 per completed survey regardless of length (5-20 minutes), so long surveys pay a poor hourly rate.
Surveys are matched to your profile and availability is not guaranteed; screen-outs mean unpaid time.
Reward options vary by country (PayPal, Bitcoin via Coinbase, Amazon/Target e-gift cards).
A verified phone number is required before payout.
Third-party testing notes a $0.50 easier-task tier in testing — the official flat rate remains $1 per standard survey.

steps: Register free on SurveyTime (web or the official app) and complete the short introductory profile survey.
Get matched with surveys via email or SMS notifications; each completed survey pays $1 regardless of length — prefer the short ones.
Complete the survey honestly; rushing or inconsistent answers can disqualify you.
After completion, choose your reward: PayPal cash, Bitcoin via Coinbase, or an Amazon/Target e-gift card (options vary by country).
Verify your phone number when prompted; the $1 reward is sent to you within minutes.
timing: Instant — reward sent within minutes of completing each survey; no withdrawal threshold.
